[SWS_CM_10450]
ara::core::InstanceSpecifier
check during the creation
of service skeleton
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00101, RS_AP_00137
⌈
The Communication Management shall check the value of the
ara::core::In-
stanceSpecifier
argument: the specifier shall be unique, using the same instance
specifier for the creation of more than one skeleton instance of the same service shall
be handled as violation according to [SWS_CORE_00090].
⌋
